senses.gloss:
घ a.^1 (Used only as the last member of comp.) Striking, killing,
 destroying; as in पाणिघ, राजघ &c.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260501. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/174.

घ + .{@-घा@} f.
—1 A blow.
—2 A tinkling ornament worn by women round the waist.
